How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JNCASR R&D Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR R&D Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the R&D Assistant post at JNCASR is 16th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the R&D Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Chemical Science and have experience in the synthesis and characterisation of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the R&D Assistant position is 28 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the R&D Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNCASR R&D Assistant job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you attach all required documents and send the application before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the R&D Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is CPMU[EMR]bs]26-27.

faq.question: Q9. Which city is the job located in?
faq.answer: The job is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position.
